spanish: Y hizo las tablas al tabernáculo: veinte tablas al lado del sur, al sur.
grammarChanges: Translated מִשְׁכָּן (H4908) as the common noun 'tabernáculo' instead of leaving it untranslated as 'mishkán'.
Translated נֶגֶב (H5045) as the common noun 'sur' instead of the proper name 'Negev'.
Translated תֵּימָנָה (H8486, with directional suffix) as 'al sur' instead of the proper name 'Temán', preserving the southward directional sense.
